planted.heading: Confidential Information
planted.note: One-way definition: only the counterparty's information is protected, ours is not.

planted.heading: Compelled Disclosure
planted.note: Compelled disclosure allowed without notifying us first.

planted.heading: Term and Survival
planted.note: Survival changed from the standard three years to perpetual.

planted.heading: Data Protection
planted.note: Personal data may go to any affiliate in any country, with no consent or safeguards.

planted.heading: Governing Law
planted.note: Governing law moved from Singapore to the Cayman Islands.
